cs.t: Hm, not a lot of linux laptop love so far so I'll throw my hat in. Last December I bought a ASUS U31 (U31SD-A1 Intel Core i3 2310M 2.10GHz 13.3" 4GB Memory 640GB HDD NVIDIA GeForce GT 520M) and I absolutely love it. The only thing that didn't work with stock ubuntu was the optimus video but with bumblebee it's fine, i only use it to switch off the nvidia anyway since 2d works fine on the intel chip.  Also if you give windows a partition it's great for games too. 10 hours of battery  life which is probably the most important feature.  I never need to worry about bringing a charger when i travel on the weekends.  I decided to replace the internal drive with an intel SSD which was spendy, but even after that the price was well below 1k.
